regulatory_descriptor: A Non-Participating, Linked, Individual, Pure Risk Health Rider
key_benefits: Out-Patient Department (OPD) benefits — tele/in-clinic doctor consultations, lab & radiology, prescribed pharmacy, complimentary gym, nutrition consultation, preventive health check-ups, care management, emotional wellness, dental (Prestige & Optima only)
Accidental Total Permanent Disability (ATPD) benefit — additional lump sum on accidental disability
Waiver of future rider premiums on ATPD — rider premiums waived for the remaining rider PPT
Premium rates guaranteed throughout the rider term
Tax benefit as per prevailing income tax laws

eligibility.policy_term: Rider Policy Term and Rider PPT must align with the base policy term and base PPT; numeric range not captured in this parse
eligibility.premium_payment_term: Aligned to base policy; numeric range not captured
eligibility.note: This is a LINKED (unit-linked) RIDER attachable to a base policy. One of five options (Prime/Pro/Ultra/Prestige/Optima) chosen at inception; option cannot be changed during the rider term. Eligibility boundary table not recovered from this parse.

key_terms.free_look_note: 30 days from receipt of the Rider Document; refund subject to proportionate risk premium, expenses and stamp duty.
key_terms.grace_period: Same as the base policy; OPD benefits cease during the grace period (accidental claims during grace handled per policy).
key_terms.suicide_clause: Not separately stated for this pure-risk health rider in this parse — handled per base policy; verify against rider policy document.
key_terms.loan_note: No loan / no maturity benefit — pure risk health rider.
key_terms.tax_note: Tax benefits as per prevailing income tax laws as amended — consult a tax advisor. GST/cess collected over and above the premium.

mandatory_disclosures_present: Disclaimer — sales literature gives salient features of the rider only; policy document is conclusive

claims_marketing_must_support: OPD service availability is option-dependent — e.g. dental and prescribed pharmacy are available ONLY with Prestige & Optima; Prime gets only pre-recorded gym sessions. Service benefits must be qualified by the chosen rider option.
ATPD benefit and waiver-of-premium trigger ONLY on Accidental Total Permanent Disability.
OPD/wellness services are delivered by third-party service providers; the Company may commence/discontinue or change providers — services are not an unconditional guarantee.
Premium rates are guaranteed throughout the rider term (this is a valid 'guaranteed' claim about premium, not about returns).
claims_marketing_must_avoid: Do NOT market this as a standalone product — it is a rider that MUST reference and be attached to an eligible base policy.
Do NOT position as an investment, savings, maturity or money-back product — it is a pure-risk health rider with no maturity benefit and no loan, despite being a 'Linked' rider.
Do NOT imply the OPD/wellness services are uncapped or permanently guaranteed — they are subject to provider availability and option limits, and the Company may change/discontinue them.
Tax benefits must not be stated as assured — carry the 'as per prevailing income tax laws' caveat.
must_state: Rider UIN 116A059V01 and reference to the base policy it is attached to
Full regulatory descriptor: 'A Non-Participating, Linked, Individual, Pure Risk Health Rider'
That OPD/wellness benefits are provided by third-party service providers and are subject to the chosen rider option and provider availability
Standard disclaimer to read the rider sales literature with the benefit illustration and policy document

gaps: Numeric entry/maturity age, rider sum-assured and rider-term boundary table not recovered from this parse.
Per-option OPD usage limits/tables not captured (referenced as tables in the source).
